decision.verdict: Meaningful architectural streamlining with temporary migration overhead.
actions: Consolidate active-profile lookup: 20 runtime files currently contain both profile-store keys.
Create a retirement plan for 28 compatibility coordinators; do not add coordinators without an explicit removal condition.
Do not extract Badge Chest until shared profile access and wrapper ownership have been reviewed against this report.
Approve future extraction only when it removes duplicate storage/global ownership, not merely when it relocates code.
